description: Fixture architecture.json exercising every checker type, exemption state, and knowledge-section path for arch-drift's own test suite.

invariants.rule: Only the ingest boundary may create FulfillmentOrder rows.
invariants.rationale: FulfillmentOrder is a local projection of an upstream order. A second creation path means rows exist with no upstream counterpart.
invariants.known_gap: Lexical. A two-line construct-then-save split across statements evades the pattern list.

invariants.rule: Search resolves against local data only.
invariants.rationale: An external index becomes a second source of truth that diverges silently.

checks.known_gap: Textual match on the manifest; a transitive dependency pulling the same package in would not be caught.
Reads the committed config file as text. A driver set only through a runtime environment variable is invisible.

invariants.rule: Every migration is reversible while data is still disposable.
invariants.rationale: Pre-production schema churn is cheap only because it can be undone.
invariants.known_gap: Brace-matched text extraction, not parsed. A down() that is syntactically present but semantically incomplete passes.

invariants.rationale: A partner being unreachable should slow the operation, not fail it.
invariants.known_gap: Proves a handler is present, not that it degrades correctly.

exemptions.reason: One-off backfill written before the ingest boundary existed. Slated for deletion, not migration.
Deliberately expired fixture: demonstrates the EXPIRED path without waiting for a real phase transition.
Fixture demonstrating a registered exemption with no currently-matching findings.

knowledge.claim: order_number is a human-readable display value. Lookups and joins use upstream_order_id.
knowledge.rationale: The display value looks enough like a key that it gets used as one.
knowledge.known_gap: Proximity heuristic over a character window; expected to produce false positives.

knowledge.claim: The carton catalog is owned upstream. This service mirrors it read-only.
knowledge.rationale: Both systems can plausibly claim ownership of box dimensions.

knowledge.claim: 'cart' means a physical picking cart in warehouse contexts and an item container in commerce contexts.
knowledge.rationale: The collision is invisible in conversation and in code review.

knowledge.claim: The upstream platform's 'wave' may not mean what 'wave' means here.
knowledge.rationale: Borrowed terminology is trusted only as far as it has been confirmed.

knowledge.claim: Whether 'wave' timing budgets in partner integrations match local expectations has not been confirmed.
knowledge.rationale: Included to exercise an unconfirmed knowledge entry that also carries a check.
